(Currently Amended) Claim 2: The method of claim 1 further comprising: __temporarily__ displaying the filtered EPG information __on a user interface__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 3: The method of claim 1 wherein filtering comprises: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber, __wherein the channel accessibility is based on subscription information and authorization__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 4: The method of claim 3 wherein obtaining comprises: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and __dynamically__ creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information.

(Currently Amended) Claim 5: The method of claim 3 wherein removing comprises: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier __from the list of the subscriber's channel identifiers if the extracted channel identifier is determined not to belong to the list__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 7: An article of manufacture comprising: a machine-accessible medium including data that, when accessed by a machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving electronic program guide (EPG) information from an EPG provider; and filtering the EPG information to retain program information related to programs delivered by a content delivery provider to a subscriber, the content delivery provider being different from the EPG provider, __wherein the filtering incorporates subscriber-specific accessibility criteria__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 8: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data further comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: __subsequently__ displaying the filtered EPG information __in a visually discernible format__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 9: The article of manufacture of claim 7 wherein the data causing the machine to perform filtering comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: obtaining channel accessibility of the subscriber; and removing EPG information related to a channel that is not within the channel accessibility of the subscriber, __wherein the channel accessibility is based on authentication measures__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 10: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform obtaining comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: retrieving channel subscription information of the subscriber from the content delivery provider; and creating a list of subscriber's channel identifiers of channels accessible to the subscriber from the channel subscription information, __with the list reflecting real-time data changes__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 11: The article of manufacture of claim 9 wherein the data causing the machine to perform removing comprises data that, when accessed by the machine, causes the machine to perform operations comprising: reading the EPG information; extracting a channel identifier from the EPG information; and removing the EPG information corresponding to the extracted channel identifier if the extracted channel identifier __is found not to belong to the updated list of the subscriber's channel identifiers__.

(Currently Amended) Claim 14: The program guide module of claim 13 wherein the enhanced EPG module further comprises: a module to __temporarily__ display the filtered EPG information __within a defined user interface environment__.
